description: Search the RAWG video game database by name, genre, or platform. Returns games with ratings, Metacritic scores, release dates, platforms, and genres. Example: search_games({ query: "zelda", ordering: "-metacritic" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own RAWG API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

genres.description: Filter by genre slug(s) or id(s), comma-separated, e.g. "action", "role-playing-games-rpg"

page_size.description: Number of games to return (default 20, max 40)

platforms.description: Filter by platform id(s), comma-separated, e.g. "4" (PC), "187" (PS5)

query.description: Search query — a game name or keyword, e.g. "elden ring", "mario"

name: search_games
title: Search Games
